questions.question: What was the age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 for all drug overdoses among all people in 1999?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Row 7 is 'All ages, age adjusted\2' under 'All people' (row 6)
# Column B is index 1 (year 1999)
val = df.iloc[6, 1]
result = float(val)

questions.question: In 2017, was the age-adjusted overdose death rate for any opioid higher in males than in females?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Opioid section starts at row 67
# Opioid Male age-adjusted row is row 82 (index 81)
# Opioid Female age-adjusted row is row 94 (index 93)
# Year 2017 is column T (index 19)
male_rate = float(df.iloc[81, 19])
female_rate = float(df.iloc[93, 19])
result = 'yes' if male_rate > female_rate else 'no'

questions.question: In 2017, which age group had the highest overdose death rate involving synthetic opioids other than methadone?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Synthetic opioids start around row 256
# Age rows for All people: rows 261 to 269 (indices 260 to 268)
# Year 2017 is column T (index 19)
age_rows = df.iloc[260:269, [0, 19]].dropna()
age_rows = age_rows[pd.to_numeric(age_rows[19], errors='coerce').notnull()].copy()
age_rows[19] = pd.to_numeric(age_rows[19])
max_row = age_rows.loc[age_rows[19].idxmax()]
result = str(max_row[0]).strip()

questions.question: What is the difference between the 2017 and 1999 age-adjusted death rates per 100,000 for heroin overdose across all individuals?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Heroin section: row 322 (index 321) is 'All ages, age adjusted\2'
# 1999 is col B (index 1), 2017 is col T (index 19)
val_1999 = float(df.iloc[321, 1])
val_2017 = float(df.iloc[321, 19])
result = round(val_2017 - val_1999, 1)

questions.question: In what year did the crude overdose death rate involving methadone across all people reach its highest value?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Methadone section crude rate: row 197 (index 196)
# Years 1999-2017 are in columns 1 to 19 (header row 5, index 4)
years = [str(int(df.iloc[4, c])) for c in range(1, 20)]
rates = [float(df.iloc[196, c]) for c in range(1, 20)]
s = pd.Series(rates, index=years)
result = s.idxmax()

questions.question: Which three age groups had the highest death rates from natural or semisynthetic opioid overdoses in 2017?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Natural or semisynthetic opioids section: rows 135 to 143 (indices 134 to 142) for age groups
# 2017 is col T (index 19)
age_data = df.iloc[134:143, [0, 19]].copy()
age_data.columns = ['age_group', 'rate']
age_data['rate'] = pd.to_numeric(age_data['rate'], errors='coerce')
top3 = age_data.sort_values(by='rate', ascending=False).head(3)
result = [str(x).strip() for x in top3['age_group'].tolist()]
